summary: LLM serving systems cache prompt KV state, yet most front ends still re-tokenize the full request text on every call. The cost lands on coding agents, which resubmit a long transcript after each small tool result, and reuse is hard because even a short append can change token boundaries near the end of the previous sequence. Across 153,951 calls from two agent ecosystems, the median call appends about 1.4K characters, and only 1.0-3.6% of calls start or rebuild a session with contexts of millions of characters. At a 94.1% fleet prompt-cache hit rate, tokenization reaches up to 64% of time to first token.   TokTier is a stateful tokenization service with one contract: emitted token IDs are always identical to full reference tokenization of the request text. For a session continuation, it re-tokenizes a small window around the append and splices only after a per-request stable-boundary check, widening the window or falling back to full tokenization on failure. For a call without a reusable prefix, it decomposes GPT-family regex pre-tokenization into run-local rules and runs exact pre-tokenization and BPE on a GPU. A sampled shadow verifier re-checks live traffic.   Across 17 tokenizer families, differential campaigns cover 1.5x10^10 split checks, a 12.4 TB real-text corpus, and 93,000+ replayed agent steps, with zero divergence. Incremental repair takes 0.5-1.1 ms from 100K to 3M characters, up to 437x faster than HF tokenization and 2.1x faster at 1M than the strongest cache-based baseline (Gigatoken) fully prewarmed. GPU full tokenization encodes a 1M-character request in 0.87 ms, up to 491x below HF and 23.4x below the fastest published CPU method. With vLLM, median time to first token drops 16-34% and P99 drops 23% under recorded bursts. Under a 50 ms P99 objective, four repair cores plus one GPU sustain 1,821 requests/s where a 16-core stateless front end saturates at 40.
title: TokTier: Exact Stateful Tokenization for Agentic LLM Serving
title_translated: TokTier：面向智能体大模型服务的精确状态化分词
summary_translated: LLM服务系统缓存提示的KV状态，但大多数前端在每次调用时仍需重新对完整请求文本进行分词。这一开销主要影响代码代理，它们在每次小工具结果后重新提交长对话记录，且由于即使短小追加也可能改变前序序列末尾的分词边界，导致复用困难。在两个代理生态系统的153,951次调用中，平均每次调用仅追加约1.4K字符，且仅有1.0%-3.6%的调用以数百万字符的上下文启动或重建会话。在94.1%的集群提示缓存命中率下，分词耗时占首次token生成时间的高达64%。TokTier是一种状态化分词服务，其唯一承诺是输出的token ID始终与完整请求文本的参考分词结果一致。对于会话续接，它仅对追加部分周围的小窗口重新分词，并在每请求稳定边界检查通过后拼接；若失败则扩大窗口或回退至全量分词。对于无可复用前缀的调用，它将GPT系列的正则预分词分解为本地运行规则，并在GPU上执行精确预分词和BPE。采样影子验证器会重新检查实时流量。在17种分词器家族中，差异性测试覆盖了1.5×10¹⁰次分割检查、12.4TB真实文本语料库以及超过93,000次重放的代理步骤，未发现任何偏差。增量修复耗时0.5-1.1毫秒（从10万到300万字符），比Hugging Face分词快最多437倍，且在100万字符时比最强的基于缓存基线（Gigatoken）快2.1倍（完全预热）。GPU全量分词可在0.87毫秒内编码100万字符请求，比HF方法快最多491倍，比最快公开的CPU方法快23.4倍。结合vLLM使用，首次token生成时间中位数降低16%-34%，P99降低23%（在记录的突发负载下）。在50毫秒P99目标下，四核修复核心加一GPU可维持1,821请求/秒，而16核无状态前端在饱和时仅能处理40请求/秒。

summary: The iterated learning model was introduced to investigate language evolution: the way in which the characteristic properties of human languages have been shaped, at least partly, by repeated transmission from one language user to another. The key finding is that language compositionality can arise spontaneously as a consequence of language being passed repeatedly through a language learning bottleneck. Here we explore how changing the frequency of different meanings, so that some meanings occur much more frequently than others, affects the character of its compositionality. We find that, as observed in natural languages, high-frequency meanings can escape the pressure to conform to the grammar that characterizes lower-frequency meanings. However, when the frequency structure is instead imposed on parts rather than on whole meaning vectors, the language fails to transmit across generations. This occurs despite the fact that the most frequent elements are reliably learned. These results suggest that frequency can shape emergent linguistic structure only when the frequency distribution is defined over form-meaning units that learners can acquire holistically. When frequency is instead distributed over smaller units, it fails to support the relational structure required for compositional generalisation, thereby preventing stable language transmission.
title: Evolving language compositionality in a frequency-structured meaning space

title_translated: 在频率结构化的意义空间中演化语言的组合性
summary_translated: 迭代学习模型被提出用于研究语言演化：人类语言的特征属性如何至少部分地由语言使用者之间的反复传递所塑造。关键发现是，语言组合性可自发产生于语言反复经过语言学习瓶颈的过程中。本文探讨了改变不同意义出现频率的影响，即某些意义远比其他意义更频繁出现，这种变化如何影响其组合性特征。我们发现，正如自然语言中观察到的那样，高频意义能够摆脱对低频意义所体现的语法压力。然而，当频率结构施加于意义向量的组成部分而非整体时，语言无法跨代传递。尽管最频繁的元素仍能被可靠学习，但这一现象仍发生。这些结果表明，频率仅在分布于学习者可整体习得的形式-意义单元时，才能塑造涌现的语言结构。当频率分布于更小单元时，它无法支持组合泛化所需的关联结构，从而阻碍了稳定语言传递。

summary: Reading a social situation often depends on behavior, not words alone. We introduce FriendBench, a benchmark for inferring whether two people are already familiar or are meeting as strangers, from a 20-second clip of a dyadic ice-breaker conversation. Every pair answers the same type of prompt, so only the manner of interaction can reveal the answer. Across text, audio, and video, we compare 26 models from seven companies against matched human panels over 96 balanced dyads. The best model and the human crowd are statistically indistinguishable on accuracy in every modality, but reach it differently: humans stay balanced across the two answers, while the strongest models lean toward "stranger"---a difference in effective prior, not discrimination. Richer channels help both unequally, and only humans gain from visible behavior on top of speech. We release the stimuli, human ratings, and model predictions.
title: FriendBench: Benchmarking Dyadic Familiarity Inference in Humans and Multimodal Large Language Models
title_translated: FriendBench：人类与多模态大语言模型中二元熟悉度推断的基准测试
summary_translated: 理解社交情境往往依赖于行为而非仅靠言语。我们引入FriendBench，一个基准测试，旨在从20秒的双人破冰对话片段中推断两人是否已相识或初次见面。每对参与者回答相同类型的问题，因此只有互动方式能揭示答案。我们在文本、音频和视频三种模态下，对比来自七家公司的26个模型与匹配的人类小组在96组平衡的二人配对中的表现。最佳模型与人类群体在各模态下的准确率统计上无显著差异，但实现方式不同：人类在两种答案间保持平衡，而最强模型倾向于“陌生人”——这是有效先验的不同，而非辨别能力的差异。更丰富的通道对两者帮助不均等，且只有人类在语音基础上还能从可见行为中获益。我们发布了刺激材料、人类评分及模型预测结果。

summary: KV cache compression is essential for efficient long-context inference. Existing eviction methods permanently discard unselected tokens and consequently remove their aggregate contribution to attention. Merging-based alternatives preserve more information but can perturb retained keys and values that should remain exact. We observe that the information omitted by cache eviction can be formulated as residual statistics in both the numerator and denominator of softmax attention. Based on this observation, we propose ResKV, which divides a fixed KV budget into an exact main cache and a compact residual cache that reconstructs the contribution of omitted tokens. ResKV lets main-cache tokens and residual entries participate in the same softmax normalization, so residual entries restore both attention numerator and denominator mass rather than acting as a post-hoc correction. A construction-time validation proxy determines residual allocation for each layer and KV head, while a decode-time dynamic gate adjusts residual contributions for individual queries. Comprehensive evaluations on LongBench and RULER, covering query-aware and query-agnostic settings, multiple backbones, cache budgets, and representative compression baselines, demonstrate broad improvements under the same retained KV budget while preserving the practical efficiency of compressed decoding, including peak memory usage and long-context decode throughput.
title: ResKV: Reconstructing Omitted Attention Contributions for Fixed-Budget KV Cache Compression
title_translated: ResKV：固定预算KV缓存压缩中被省略注意力贡献的重构
summary_translated: KV缓存压缩对于高效长上下文推理至关重要。现有淘汰方法永久丢弃未选中的token，因而移除了它们对注意力的累积贡献。基于合并的替代方案虽保留更多信息，但可能扰动应保持精确的保留键值。我们观察到，缓存淘汰所遗漏的信息可形式化为softmax注意力中分子和分母的残差统计量。基于此，我们提出ResKV，将固定KV预算划分为精确主缓存和紧凑残差缓存，后者用于重构被省略token的贡献。ResKV使主缓存token与残差条目参与相同的softmax归一化，因此残差条目同时恢复注意力分子和分母的质量，而非作为事后修正。构建时的验证代理决定每层和每个KV头的残差分配，解码时的动态门控则根据具体查询调整残差贡献。在LongBench和RULER上的全面评估涵盖查询感知与查询无关设置、多种骨干网络、缓存预算及代表性压缩基线，证明在相同保留KV预算下具有广泛改进，同时保持压缩解码的实际效率，包括峰值内存占用和长上下文解码吞吐量。

summary: To maintain common ground in cooperative conversation, humans iteratively update their beliefs as conversation participants share new information; participants who are epistemically vigilant detect when new information conflicts with prior beliefs and take steps to repair these conflicts. In order for AI systems to serve as reliable partners in complex cooperative tasks, they must similarly weigh incoming information against their own private evidence and shared context and appropriately surface inconsistencies when they arise. To measure the epistemic vigilance of vision-language models in cooperative settings, we present an information-asymmetric, dialog-based "spot-the-difference" task. Two models are privately shown one image each, and must determine through conversation whether the images are identical or, if not, identify the difference. Models routinely fail at this: they frequently overlook key evidence in their private image in favor of agreeing with their conversational partner, even when their agreement is unwarranted. We relate these violations of epistemic vigilance to the broader behavior of sycophancy, which manifests itself in cooperative goal-oriented dialog as over-accommodation and weak evidential grounding. Our results show that model steering to reduce sycophancy with a vector learned from task-agnostic sycophancy examples can reduce epistemic vigilance-related errors, making models more faithful reporters of their evidence, and in turn, more reliable partners in information-asymmetric cooperative tasks.
title: Sycophancy Undermines Epistemic Vigilance in Cooperative Vision-Language Tasks
title_translated: 阿谀奉承削弱了合作视觉-语言任务中的认知警觉性
summary_translated: 为了在合作对话中维持共同基础，人类会随着对话参与者分享新信息而不断更新信念；具备认知警觉性的参与者能察觉新信息与既有信念的冲突，并采取措施修复这些矛盾。为了让AI系统在复杂合作任务中成为可靠的伙伴，它们也必须权衡输入信息与其自身私有证据和共享背景，并在出现不一致时恰当地揭示。为衡量视觉-语言模型在合作情境中的认知警觉性，我们设计了一个信息不对称、基于对话的“找不同”任务。两个模型各自私密地看到一张图像，需通过对话判断图像是否相同，若不同则识别差异。模型常在此任务中失败：它们经常忽视自己私有图像中的关键证据，转而盲目迎合对话伙伴，即使其同意并不合理。我们将这些认知警觉性失效现象与更广泛的阿谀奉承行为相关联，该行为在合作目标导向对话中表现为过度迎合和弱证据基础。我们的结果表明，通过使用任务无关的阿谀奉承示例学习的向量对模型进行引导，可减少阿谀奉承，从而降低与认知警觉性相关的错误，使模型更忠实于其证据，进而成为信息不对称合作任务中更可靠的伙伴。

summary: Standard AI-text detection benchmarks compare human-written text against text generated directly by large language models (LLMs). While prior work has shown that rewriting and paraphrasing can degrade detector performance, it remains unclear whether performance measured on this conventional benchmark predicts detector behavior when human-authored content is rewritten by an LLM. To address this gap, we introduce Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB), built from 1,800 human source texts (600 each from XSum, WritingPrompts, and OpenWebText) and four open-weight generators (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-9B). Each source item yields four matched variants: human-written (HUMAN), direct LLM generation (Free-LLM), LLM-rewritten human text (H2L), and same-generator LLM-rewritten LLM text (LLM2L). We evaluated five detectors (FastDetectGPT, Binoculars-falcon-7b, RADAR, BERT-Defense, RoBERTa-Defense) at a strict 1%-false-positive operating point (TPR@1%FPR). FastDetectGPT and Binoculars-falcon-7b detected 91.2% and 93.5\% of direct LLM text, but only 30.8% and 15.1% of human text an LLM had rewritten, a drop of 60-78 percentage points. The same detectors retained 78.3% and 83.0% recall when LLM text was rewritten by the same model, a much smaller decline of 10-13 points. RADAR followed the same pattern (66.8% to 12.2%), while BERT-Defense and RoBERTa-Defense stayed below 3% recall across all regimes. These results show that detector performance measured on the conventional human-vs-LLM benchmark does not transfer to human-authored text revised by an LLM, even though the same detectors remain largely robust to LLM-only rewriting.
title: ARB: A Matched Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark Dataset for AI-Text Detector Evaluation
title_translated: ARB：用于AI文本检测器评估的匹配作者重写基准数据集
summary_translated: 标准的AI文本检测基准将人工撰写文本与大型语言模型（LLMs）直接生成的文本进行比较。尽管先前的研究表明重写和改写会降低检测器性能，但目前尚不清楚在传统基准上测得的性能是否能预测当人类撰写的文本被LLM重写时检测器的实际表现。为填补这一空白，我们提出了作者重写基准（ARB），该数据集基于1800个原始人类文本（XSum、WritingPrompts和OpenWebText各600个）以及四种开源权重生成器（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B）。每个源文本生成四个匹配变体：人工撰写（HUMAN）、直接LLM生成（Free-LLM）、LLM重写的原有人类文本（H2L）以及同一生成器重写的LLM文本（LLM2L）。我们在严格1%假阳性率的操作点（TPR@1%FPR）下评估了五种检测器（FastDetectGPT、Binoculars-falcon-7b、RADAR、BERT-Defense、RoBERTa-Defense）。FastDetectGPT和Binoculars-falcon-7b对直接LLM文本的检测率分别为91.2%和93.5%，但对LLM重写的原有人类文本的检测率分别降至30.8%和15.1%，下降幅度达60-78个百分点。而当LLM文本被同一模型重写时，这些检测器的召回率仍保持在78.3%和83.0%，下降幅度仅为10-13点。RADAR也呈现相同趋势（从66.8%降至12.2%），而BERT-Defense和RoBERTa-Defense在所有场景下的召回率均低于3%。结果表明，传统的人类 vs LLM 基准上的检测器性能无法推广到LLM重写的原有人类文本，即使这些检测器对仅LLM重写的情况仍具有较强的鲁棒性。

summary: Interventional data is widely regarded as the gold standard for teaching models causal reasoning. We test this assumption in a fully controlled synthetic environment pitting observational correlation against causal effect, and find it fails instructively. In Simpson's-paradox worlds, where the two have systematically opposite signs, increasing the fraction of interventional samples in pretraining does not improve causal direction: the magnitude of the model's do()-response grows monotonically, yet its sign is copied from the observational context. What governs whether interventional evidence is used is not the training mixture but the evidence type present in the context at inference time. Under an identical training recipe, a purely observational context induces systematic sign reversal in 29/50 worlds, a mixed context in 19/50, while aligned interventional probes alone yield 41/50 correct. Erasing observational evidence from the context immediately releases the suppressed causal interpolation ability (ratio_true = +0.56); a four-state content manipulation shows the switch is content-mediated and graded. The suppression is stable across training seeds (11/11 strong reversals persist on a matched-protocol second seed) and robust as a rate at 0.93B parameters (31.8% vs. 6% reversals in the matched probe-only arm), even as absolute gains shrink four-fold. An external audit on CLadder exposes a learned positive-effect prior with a two-layer structure: sign-randomized retraining removes it in-distribution but not out-of-distribution. We summarize: the capability lives in the weights; the switch lives in the context, and activation patching localizes the switch to the middle layers' observational rows. We further quantify the sampling noise floor of probe-based causal evaluation and an evidence-averaging protocol that cuts sign errors from 26% to 9%.
title: Evidence-Type Competition: When Can Interventional Data Teach Language Models Causal Direction?
title_translated: 证据类型竞争：干预数据何时能教会语言模型因果方向？
summary_translated: 干预数据普遍被认为是教授模型因果推理的黄金标准。我们在一个完全受控的合成环境中测试了这一假设，将观察性相关性与因果效应进行对比，发现该假设在特定情况下失效。在辛普森悖论世界中，两者符号系统相反，增加预训练中干预样本的比例并不能提升模型对因果方向的判断能力：模型的do()-响应幅度持续增长，但其符号仍由观察性上下文决定。决定是否使用干预证据的并非训练混合比例，而是推理时上下文中存在的证据类型。在相同的训练设置下，纯观察性上下文导致29/50个世界出现系统性符号反转，混合上下文导致19/50个，而仅使用一致的干预探针则有41/50个正确。若从上下文中移除观察性证据，被抑制的因果推断能力立即恢复（ratio_true = +0.56）；四状态内容操控实验表明该切换是内容驱动且渐进的。这种抑制在不同训练种子间稳定存在（11/11次强反转在匹配协议的第二种子中持续），且在0.93B参数规模下仍具鲁棒性（匹配探针仅臂中反转率为31.8% vs. 6%），尽管绝对增益缩小四倍。外部审计CLadder揭示了一个具有两层结构的正向效应先验：符号随机化再训练可在分布内消除该先验，但无法在分布外消除。总结如下：能力存在于权重中；开关存在于上下文中；激活修补定位该开关至中间层的观察行。我们进一步量化了基于探针的因果评估采样噪声下限，并提出一种证据平均协议，将符号错误从26%降至9%。

summary: As large language model (LLM) agents evolve into personalized companions, memory has emerged as a core capability. However, LLMs face a knowledge utilization problem: they may fail to act on relevant user preferences even when they are fully present in context. When an agent fails to tailor its response in a context where previously shared user preferences should matter, it is unclear whether the model failed to remember that information or remembered it but failed to use it. To isolate this breakdown, we introduce a decoupled evaluation paradigm that administers paired Know and Act tests to the same user preference. We conduct large-scale experiments across 16 systems and five memory architectures, evaluating 1,000 preferences embedded at three levels of expression strength. Our results show a large gap between Know and Act outcomes: agents often pass the recall test for a user preference but fail to reflect that same preference in the paired behavioral scenario. While memory architectures reduce this gap, utilization remains especially weak for health and therapy-related preferences, where failures to act carry the greatest real-world stakes.
title: Know It, Act on It: Investigating Memory Utilization in LLM Personalization
title_translated: 知之，行之：探究LLM个性化中的记忆利用问题
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）代理演变为个性化的伴侣，记忆已成为核心能力。然而，LLM面临知识利用难题：即使用户偏好信息完整地存在于上下文中，模型也可能无法据此采取相应行动。当代理在应反映先前共享用户偏好的情境中未能调整回应时，难以判断是模型未能记住该信息，还是记住了却未加以使用。为分离这一故障环节，我们引入了一种解耦式评估范式，对同一用户偏好同时执行‘知晓’与‘行动’测试。我们在16个系统和五种记忆架构上开展大规模实验，评估了嵌入三个表达强度层级的1000条用户偏好。结果显示，‘知晓’与‘行动’之间存在巨大差距：代理常能通过偏好回忆测试，但在对应的行动场景中却未能体现该偏好。尽管记忆架构可缩小这一差距，但在健康与心理治疗相关偏好上，利用能力尤为薄弱，此类失败在现实世界中影响最大。

summary: Deploying large language models in realistic server environments poses challenges, as the system needs to provide high-quality responses with low latency. Quantization is a common approach to reduce the memory footprint and improve inference efficiency, yet its impact on latency and throughput is rarely evaluated under controlled, orchestration-level workloads. In this work we study the quantization trade-offs of two translation model families, EuroLLM \citep{martins2025eurollm} and Hy-MT2 \citep{zheng2026hy} across five models ranging from 1.7B to 22B for efficient deployment on a single A100 or H100 GPU. We demonstrate that combining a document-chunking strategy with W4A8 or W8A8 quantization improves the latency-throughput Pareto-curve under a wide range of workloads. Furthermore, since standard machine translation (MT) benchmarks rely on isolated sentences and fail to capture long-context dynamics, we introduce a document-level evaluation from WMT24++ to assess how text chunking strategies affect translation quality under quantization. Our results reveal that standard segment-level evaluation can fail to predict the interaction between quantization and long-context document translation. While Hy-MT2 remains robust under quantization, EuroLLM shows strong sensitivity and translation quality collapses rapidly for all considered quantization formats. Overall, our experiments show that the trade-off between inference efficiency and translation quality depends not only on the quantization format, but also on the choice of text chunking strategy.
title: Studying quantization trade-offs for efficient inference deployment in machine translation
title_translated: 研究量化权衡以实现机器翻译中的高效推理部署
summary_translated: 在真实服务器环境中部署大型语言模型面临挑战，系统需在低延迟下提供高质量响应。量化是一种常用方法，可减少内存占用并提升推理效率，但其对延迟和吞吐量的影响很少在受控的编排级工作负载下进行评估。本研究针对两种翻译模型家族（EuroLLM和Hy-MT2）在五个模型（1.7B至22B）上研究量化权衡，以实现单张A100或H100 GPU上的高效部署。我们证明，将文档分块策略与W4A8或W8A8量化结合，可在多种工作负载下改善延迟-吞吐量帕累托曲线。此外，由于标准机器翻译（MT）基准依赖孤立句子，无法捕捉长上下文动态，我们引入了来自WMT24++的文档级评估，以分析文本分块策略在量化条件下的翻译质量影响。结果表明，标准的段落级评估可能无法预测量化与长上下文文档翻译之间的相互作用。虽然Hy-MT2在量化下保持稳健，但EuroLLM表现出强烈敏感性，所有考虑的量化格式下翻译质量迅速崩溃。总体而言，我们的实验表明，推理效率与翻译质量之间的权衡不仅取决于量化格式，还取决于文本分块策略的选择。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate text by auto-regressively sampling the next token. This inherently leads to a many-to-many mapping between prompts and responses, complicating the task of inferring prompts from observed outputs. Prior work on LLM inversion frames prompt recovery as a semantic reconstruction task. They rely on fine-tuning pretrained sequence-to-sequence models on large external datasets--and requiring access to model weights or logits--to generate semantically plausible prompts. In contrast, we present a functional approach to inverting a given LLM in a black-box setting, without auxiliary aids. We train an explicit inverse language model entirely from scratch on data synthetically generated from the target LLM itself. Analogous to forward next-token prediction, our inverse model is trained using previous-token prediction, establishing a generative link between the forward and inverse processes that enables faithful prompt reconstruction. Moreover, it naturally supports diverse prompt reconstructions through sampling, whereby all such prompts induce similar responses under the forward, target LLM. Our approach generalises across datasets and exhibits transferability in reconstructing prompts from responses generated by different LLMs. Further, across the set of token based evaluation metrics for prompt and response reconstructions, our approach outperforms prior work.
title: PTP: Previous-Token Prediction based LLM Inversion for Near-Exact Prompt Reconstruction
title_translated: 基于前一标记预测的LLM反演：实现近乎精确的提示重建
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过自回归方式逐标记采样生成文本，这本质上导致提示与响应之间存在多对多映射，使得从观测输出中推断提示变得复杂。先前的LLM反演工作将提示恢复视为语义重构任务，依赖在大型外部数据集上微调预训练序列到序列模型——且需要访问模型权重或logits——来生成语义合理的提示。相比之下，我们提出一种无需辅助工具的黑盒功能性反演方法。我们完全从零开始训练一个显式的逆语言模型，数据来源于目标LLM自身生成的合成数据。类似于正向下一个标记预测，我们的逆模型通过前一标记预测进行训练，建立正向与逆向过程之间的生成关联，从而实现忠实的提示重建。此外，它天然支持通过采样生成多样化的提示重建，所有此类提示在正向目标LLM下均诱导相似响应。我们的方法在跨数据集上具有泛化能力，并展现出在不同LLM生成响应中重建提示的可迁移性。在一系列基于标记的提示与响应重建评估指标上，我们的方法优于先前工作。

summary: LLM agents need memory to act consistently over long interactions, yet many systems use additional LLM calls to operate that memory. Generating intermediate records and mediating their retrieval adds recurring token and time costs, while omitted or merged details can obscure the original evidence. We ask whether structured memory access requires generation at all. Zero-Mem introduces \emph{zero-token memory operations}: no step outside final question answering invokes an LLM or consumes LLM input or output tokens; encoder computation is accounted for separately. Zero-Mem preserves original interaction traces as its source of record. It organizes the traces in two complementary ways. An entity--context graph exposes connections across interactions, while a temporal hierarchy preserves conversational locality and session state. For each query, Zero-Mem weighs the two views, retrieves from both, and follows their structure to recover supporting relations or surrounding context. Deterministic calibration first discards conflicting evidence and then keeps the reader's answer grounded in the retrieved traces. Only the final-QA reader invokes an LLM. Across long-memory and long-context question-answering benchmarks, Zero-Mem achieves competitive performance while eliminating LLM calls and LLM-token consumption from memory operations. With the same final-QA reader and context budget, it reduces memory-operation time cost by 57.6\% relative to the fastest compared baseline. Ablations support the contribution of the two views and their query-dependent coordination. Overall, the results show that structured agent memory need not generate an intermediate representation of the past. After peer review, the code and implementation details will be available at \textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/TheMoon0815/Zero-mem}.
title: Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents
title_translated: Zero-Mem：用于大语言模型智能体的零令牌记忆操作
summary_translated: 大语言模型智能体需要记忆以在长时间交互中保持一致性，但许多系统通过额外的LLM调用操作记忆。生成中间记录并中介其检索会带来持续的令牌和时间成本，而遗漏或合并的细节可能模糊原始证据。我们探讨结构化记忆访问是否真的需要生成过程。Zero-Mem引入了	extit{零令牌记忆操作}：除最终问答步骤外，任何阶段都不调用LLM，也不消耗LLM输入或输出令牌；编码计算单独计费。Zero-Mem将原始交互痕迹作为其记录来源，并以两种互补方式组织：实体-上下文图揭示跨交互的关联，时间层次结构保留对话局部性和会话状态。对于每个查询，Zero-Mem权衡这两种视图，从两者中检索，并遵循其结构以恢复支持关系或周围上下文。确定性校准首先剔除冲突证据，然后确保阅读器的答案基于检索到的痕迹。只有最终问答阅读器调用LLM。在长记忆和长上下文问答基准测试中，Zero-Mem实现了具有竞争力的表现，同时消除了记忆操作中的LLM调用和LLM令牌消耗。在相同最终问答阅读器和上下文预算下，相比最快基线，其记忆操作时间成本降低了57.6%。消融实验支持两种视图及其查询依赖协调的贡献。总体而言，结果表明结构化智能体记忆无需生成过去的中间表示。经同行评审后，代码与实现细节将发布于\textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/TheMoon0815/Zero-mem}。

summary: Cross-lingual transfer is central to low-resource machine translation, but its behavior within closely related language families remains insufficiently characterized. We study transfer among five Turkic languages; Turkish, Azerbaijani, Uzbek, Kazakh, and Kyrgyz; using pairwise transfer matrices. In this setting, each model is fine-tuned with one transfer source and evaluated on a different transfer target while the translation target remains the same. Across mT5 experiments, we find that transfer is strongest between closely related Turkic pairs, especially Turkish-Azerbaijani and Kazakh-Kyrgyz. We also show that transfer direction matters, and that the same transfer source-transfer target pair can behave differently when the translation target changes. Latinization improves BLEU and chrF in several script-mismatched settings, but its effect is not uniform across metrics. Additional analyses show that transfer sources are mostly stable across different datasets and model settings.
title: Cross-Lingual Transfer for Machine Translation in Turkic Languages
title_translated: 突厥语族机器翻译中的跨语言迁移
summary_translated: 跨语言迁移在低资源机器翻译中至关重要，但其在密切相关的语言家族内的行为仍缺乏充分描述。我们研究了五种突厥语族语言（土耳其语、阿塞拜疆语、乌兹别克语、哈萨克语和吉尔吉斯语）之间的迁移，采用成对迁移矩阵。在此设置中，每个模型使用一个迁移源进行微调，并在不同迁移目标上评估，而翻译目标保持不变。在mT5实验中，我们发现密切相关的突厥语对之间迁移效果最强，尤其是土耳其语-阿塞拜疆语和哈萨克语-吉尔吉斯语。我们还表明迁移方向很重要，同一源-目标对在不同翻译目标下表现可能不同。拉丁化在多个脚本不匹配场景中提升了BLEU和chrF得分，但对不同指标的影响并不一致。进一步分析显示，迁移源在不同数据集和模型设置中大多保持稳定。

summary: Multi-domain machine translation (MDMT) poses a unique challenge due to varying levels of linguistic complexity across domains. Inspired by human translators' ability to adapt reasoning effort based on difficulty, we propose TwT (Translation with Thought), a resource-rational framework that learns to modulate inference between intuitive and deliberate reasoning. TwT is trained in two stages: (1) supervised fine-tuning on difficulty-aware long chain-of-thought traces distilled from DeepSeek-R1 and rewritten by GPT-4o to reflect human-like reasoning economy, and (2) reinforcement learning with a hybrid reward to optimize translation quality and reasoning efficiency. Evaluated on 15 benchmarks spanning in-domain and out-of-domain settings, as well as 3 seen and 59 unseen languages, with ablations across three backbone models, TwT-7B and TwT-14B outperform much larger SOTA reasoning models in translation quality, while reducing token usage by 32--60\%. These results confirm that aligning translation behavior with cognitive principles enables robust generalization, high translation quality, and efficient reasoning in MDMT.
title: Translation with Thought: Difficulty-Adaptive Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Domain Machine Translation

title_translated: 带思考的翻译：基于强化学习的多领域机器翻译难度自适应推理
summary_translated: 多领域机器翻译（MDMT）因各领域语言复杂度差异而面临独特挑战。受人类译者根据难度调整推理努力能力的启发，我们提出TwT（带思考的翻译），一种资源理性框架，可学习在直觉式与深思熟虑式推理之间调节推理过程。TwT分两阶段训练：(1) 在来自DeepSeek-R1的难度感知长思维链轨迹上进行监督微调，由GPT-4o重写以反映类人推理经济性；(2) 使用混合奖励进行强化学习，优化翻译质量与推理效率。在涵盖域内与域外设置、3个已见与59个未见语言的15个基准上进行评估，三种骨干模型的消融实验表明，TwT-7B和TwT-14B在翻译质量上优于更大规模的SOTA推理模型，同时减少32%至60%的令牌使用量。这些结果证实，将翻译行为与认知原则对齐，可实现稳健泛化、高质量翻译和高效推理。在多领域机器翻译中具有显著优势。

summary: Reliable evaluation of open-ended LLM outputs requires fine-grained rubrics, yet expert curation is costly and difficult to scale. Existing automated pipelines rely on strict judge unanimity and binary variance filters, which cannot distinguish measurable rubrics from informative ones. We introduce CalibratedRubric, a task-adaptive framework that combines type-specific scoring, Bayesian rubric-measurability filtering, and item response theory (IRT)-based bank assembly. CalibratedRubric estimates each rubric's measurability with a Beta--Bernoulli agreement posterior and uses a submodular information-coverage objective to construct compact rubric banks over the observed capability range. Across financial, healthcare, general, and legal benchmarks, measurability filtering improves human-gold agreement on JudgmentBench from $κ=0.604$ to $0.743$. IRT-based greedy selection improves cross-fitted rank fidelity over random selection across all six evaluated response blocks and requires only 49 rather than 131 rubrics to reach the target correlation on FinResearchBench decision-support tasks. Task-label perturbations further reduce system separation, confirming the practical relevance of task-adaptive scoring. These results support CalibratedRubric as an efficient, uncertainty-aware approach to open-ended LLM evaluation, with calibration gains depending on sufficient judge redundancy.
title: CalibratedRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubric Banks for Open-Ended LLM Evaluation
title_translated: CalibratedRubric：面向开放式LLM评估的任务自适应评分库
summary_translated: 可靠评估开放式LLM输出需要细粒度评分标准，但专家制定成本高且难以扩展。现有自动化流程依赖严格的评委一致性和二元方差过滤，无法区分可测量评分与信息丰富评分。我们提出CalibratedRubric，一种任务自适应框架，结合特定类型评分、贝叶斯评分可测量性过滤以及基于项目反应理论（IRT）的评分库构建。CalibratedRubric使用Beta-Bernoulli协议估计每个评分的可测量性，并采用子模信息覆盖目标构建覆盖观测能力范围的紧凑评分库。在金融、医疗、通用和法律基准上，可测量性过滤使JudgmentBench的人工黄金标准一致性从κ=0.604提升至0.743。基于IRT的贪心选择在所有六个评估响应块上均优于随机选择，仅需49个而非131个评分即可在FinResearchBench决策支持任务中达到目标相关性。任务标签扰动进一步降低系统分离度，证实任务自适应评分的实际意义。这些结果支持CalibratedRubric作为一种高效、不确定性感知的开放式LLM评估方法，其校准增益依赖于足够的评委冗余。

summary: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive for agentic deployment due to low latency, reduced cost, and on-device privacy, yet they struggle with tool-use tasks where training data is scarce and noisy. Unlike larger models, SLMs cannot compensate for low-quality supervision through sheer capacity, making data quality the critical bottleneck. We present Data Turnstile, an open-source framework that takes user-defined API specifications and generates high-quality synthetic training data for function calling. Turnstile decomposes multi-turn tool-use interactions into constrained, stepwise generation with validation and error-feedback loops, providing fine-grained control over API diversity, conversation complexity, and output correctness. We demonstrate effectiveness of domain adaptation with Turnstile data on two challenging function calling benchmarks. On the BFCL single-turn benchmark, a Qwen3-0.6B fine-tuned on Turnstile data without chain-of-thought achieves 75.9% overall accuracy (versus 67.4% for the base model with thinking enabled), closing the gap with thinking-enabled Qwen3-1.7B (78.4%) and Qwen3-4B (79.9%) despite being 3$\times$ and 7$\times$ smaller respectively. On $τ^2$-bench, a multi-turn agentic benchmark, Turnstile-trained Qwen3-1.7B achieves 31.1% pass^1 on the Telecom domain, improving 4.7$\times$ over its 6.6% base and surpassing Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (27.4%), a model 19$\times$ larger. Turnstile-trained Qwen3-0.6B achieves 24.6%, improving 7$\times$ over its 3.5% base and approaching the 32B model (53$\times$ larger). We release Data Turnstile along with a dataset spanning 1,000+ APIs and 100K+ multi-turn interactions.
title: Data Turnstile: A Scalable Open Framework for Function-Calling Data Generation
title_translated: Data Turnstile：面向函数调用数据生成的可扩展开放框架
summary_translated: 小型语言模型（SLMs）因其低延迟、低成本和本地隐私优势，适合智能体部署，但在工具使用任务中面临训练数据稀缺且噪声大的问题。与大型模型不同，SLMs无法通过模型容量弥补低质量监督，因此数据质量成为关键瓶颈。我们提出Data Turnstile，一个开源框架，可根据用户定义的API规范生成高质量合成训练数据用于函数调用。Turnstile将多轮工具使用交互分解为受约束的逐步生成过程，包含验证与错误反馈循环，对API多样性、对话复杂度和输出正确性提供精细控制。我们在两个具有挑战性的函数调用基准上展示了Turnstile数据在领域适应方面的有效性。在BFCL单轮基准上，基于Turnstile数据微调的Qwen3-0.6B模型（无思维链）整体准确率达75.9%（对比启用思维链的基线模型为67.4%），接近启用思维链的Qwen3-1.7B（78.4%）和Qwen3-4B（79.9%），尽管其规模分别小3倍和7倍。在$τ^2$-bench多轮智能体基准上，Turnstile训练的Qwen3-1.7B在电信领域取得31.1% pass^1成绩，较其基线6.6%提升4.7倍，并超过19倍更大的Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct（27.4%）。Turnstile训练的Qwen3-0.6B达24.6%，较其基线3.5%提升7倍，接近53倍更大的32B模型。我们已发布Data Turnstile及涵盖1000+ API和10万+多轮交互的数据集。

summary: InMyStyle is a privacy first, single user system that adapts small language models to rewrite AI-edited text towards an individual user's writing style without an instruction prompt at inference. Given a user's documents, it uses multiple local helper LLMs to construct paired training examples and fine tunes LoRA adapters on base models ranging from 0.5B to 7B parameters. Length aware generation budgets and automatic chunking support inputs of different lengths. On 219 evaluation pairs from a scientific-paper corpus, the automatic composite score plateaus at 0.69 [scale 0-1] across all model sizes under both greedy and sampled decoding. This observed plateau suggests that small models are sufficient for the measured rewriting task, with model size determining trade-offs rather than a stable quality ranking. As a secondary evaluation, 400 ratings from five LLM judges give InMyStyle outputs a mean perceived AI-ness score over 20% lower than their helper-AI generated inputs, while mean perceived AI-ness scores decrease with model size within InMyStyle.
title: Small Is Enough: Per-User Style Rewriting of AI-Edited Text via LoRA Adapters
title_translated: 小即是够：通过LoRA适配器实现用户级风格重写
summary_translated: InMyStyle 是一个以隐私为先的单用户系统，能够在推理阶段无需指令提示的情况下，将小型语言模型适配以将AI编辑过的文本重写为符合个人写作风格。给定用户的文档，该系统使用多个本地辅助LLM构建成对训练样本，并在参数规模从0.5B到7B的基础模型上微调LoRA适配器。长度感知生成预算和自动分块支持不同长度输入。在来自科学论文语料库的219个评估对上，无论采用贪婪解码还是采样解码，自动综合得分均稳定在0.69（0-1量表），表明小模型已足够完成该重写任务，模型大小仅决定权衡而非稳定质量排名。作为次要评估，5个LLM裁判给出的400个评分显示，InMyStyle输出的平均感知AI程度比其辅助AI生成的输入低超过20%，且在InMyStyle内部，随着模型规模增大，平均感知AI程度持续下降。

summary: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this \textit{futile reasoning} phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration between capability and behavior. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, which outputs look superficially valid but contain subtle errors, escalating with task difficulty. To address this, we introduce \textbf{CaRL} (\textbf{Ca}pability-\textbf{a}ligned \textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning), which aligns model behavior with capability boundaries through reward shaping that incentivizes refusal over futile reasoning and hindsight refusal augmentation that converts failures into refusal supervision. Experiments demonstrate a substantial reduction in futile reasoning while preserving performance across task difficulties, effectively achieving capability-aligned behavior without sacrificing utility. \footnote{https://github.com/icip-cas/Knowing-When-to-Quit}
title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
title_translated: 知何时停止：诊断并训练LLM以中止无用推理
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在超出能力范围的任务上会产生计算成本高昂但语义空洞的推理，导致用户被看似合理实则错误的推导误导。我们通过系统性分析刻画了这种‘无用推理’现象，揭示出普遍的能力超限以及能力和行为之间的系统性校准偏差。主要失败模式是伪推理，即输出表面看似有效但包含细微错误，且随任务难度上升而加剧。为此，我们提出CaRL（能力对齐强化学习），通过奖励塑造激励拒绝无用推理，并利用事后拒绝增强将失败转化为拒绝监督。实验表明，在保持跨任务难度性能的同时，显著减少了无用推理，有效实现了能力对齐的行为，且未牺牲实用性。

summary: Long-running multi-turn interactions with chatbots and agents are now common, and a correct response often depends on remembering earlier details, tracking later revisions, identifying intended objects or referents, and withholding action when required conditions are unmet. Existing multi-turn benchmarks typically cover short exchanges and do not fully evaluate these capabilities in long multi-turn interactions, particularly in Chinese, while offering limited insight into how and why models fail. To address these limitations, we analyze real chatbot failures to identify six recurring mechanisms and use them to define six controlled evaluation modes in Hy-MultiTurn, a Chinese benchmark for deep multi-turn dialogue understanding. The six modes evaluate constraint memory, precise execution, constraint synthesis, object localization, action suppression, and reference resolution. Across the six modes, we construct 209 controlled tasks spanning 12-76 turns, with dialogue length, irrelevant-topic distraction, and colloquial phrasing adding further difficulty. Evaluation of 22 frontier model configurations shows that Hy-MultiTurn is broadly challenging, as even GPT-5.5, the strongest overall configuration, satisfies all requirements in only 41.1 percent of responses and no model performs best in all six modes.
title: Hy-MultiTurn: A Six-Dimensional Benchmark for Deep Multi-Turn Dialogue Understanding
title_translated: Hy-MultiTurn：深度多轮对话理解的六维基准测试
summary_translated: 与聊天机器人和智能体的长期多轮交互已成为常态，正确回应往往依赖于记住早期细节、追踪后续修改、识别目标对象或指代物，以及在条件不满足时抑制行动。现有多轮对话基准通常仅覆盖短对话，未能充分评估长多轮交互中的这些能力，尤其在中文场景下，且对模型失败原因和机制缺乏深入洞察。为解决这些问题，我们分析真实聊天机器人失败案例，识别出六种常见机制，并据此定义Hy-MultiTurn这一中文深度多轮对话理解基准的六个受控评估模式。这六个模式分别评估约束记忆、精确执行、约束合成、对象定位、动作抑制和指代消解。在六个模式下，我们构建了209个受控任务，涵盖12至76轮对话，对话长度、无关话题干扰和口语化表达进一步增加了难度。对22个前沿模型配置的评估显示，Hy-MultiTurn具有广泛挑战性，即使最强的GPT-5.5也仅在41.1%的回应中满足所有要求，且无模型在所有六种模式中表现最佳。

summary: Migrants traversing geographically distinct routes such as the Trans-Saharan and Balkan corridors often recount strikingly parallel lived experiences: police violence, smuggler exploitation, dangerous crossings, and family separation. We introduce the task of experiential intertextuality detection: automatically identifying shared experiential echoes across migration narratives without requiring annotated training data. From 108 French migration narratives spanning both corridors, we automatically generate sentence pairs and score them using annotation-free methods: lexical baselines, sentence embeddings, POS-based structural features, a migration-specific theme lexicon, context-aware narrative features, and zero-shot LLM scoring with Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B under three prompting strategies. We validate all methods against 816 expert-annotated intertextuality judgments (inter-annotator Krippendorff's $α= 0.27$). Our results reveal that all surface, structural, and embedding methods correlate only weakly with expert judgments ($r \leq 0.30$); Qwen2.5-7B zero-shot achieves the best single-method correlation ($r = 0.38$); few-shot examples degrade Qwen but dramatically improve Mistral; narrative position significantly predicts intertextuality, with departure-phase pairs showing the highest experiential echoes; and a supervised hybrid combining all 31 features achieves $r = 0.45$, a 21% improvement over the best individual method.
title: Detecting Experiential Intertextuality Across Migration Routes: Beyond Surface Similarity in French Narratives
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at SIGDIAL 2026 (27th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue)
title_translated: 跨越迁徙路线检测经验性互文性：超越法语文本表面相似性
summary_translated: 穿越地理上截然不同的迁徙路线（如撒哈拉以南和巴尔干走廊）的移民常描述惊人相似的生活经历：警察暴力、走私者剥削、危险渡河和家庭分离。我们提出了经验性互文性检测任务：在无需标注训练数据的前提下，自动识别迁徙叙事中共享的经验回响。基于涵盖两条走廊的108篇法语文本，我们自动生成句子对，并使用无标注方法进行评分：词汇基线、句向量、词性结构特征、迁移特定主题词典、上下文感知叙事特征，以及在三种提示策略下使用Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B的零样本LLM评分。所有方法均通过816个专家标注的互文性判断进行验证（标注者间Krippendorff's α=0.27）。结果表明，所有表面、结构和嵌入方法与专家判断的相关性均较弱（r ≤ 0.30）；Qwen2.5-7B零样本达到最佳单一方法相关性（r = 0.38）；少量示例会降低Qwen表现但大幅提升Mistral；叙事位置显著预测互文性，出发阶段的句子对表现出最高经验共鸣；而结合全部31个特征的有监督混合模型达到r = 0.45，相比最佳单方法提升21%。

summary: Reward models (RMs) are central to aligning large language models with human preferences via reinforcement learning. Although traditional scalar RMs enable efficient and probabilistic reward modeling, they rely on superficial cues that fail to generalize to complex or out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. Conversely, generative RMs leverage extensive reasoning to improve robustness on challenging tasks, but their natural language-based scores lack the numerical flexibility and probabilistic interpretability that scalar RMs offer. While recent approaches combine both paradigms through off-policy multi-task learning, such parallel optimization does not guarantee that generated reasoning traces actively align with or benefit downstream scalar reward prediction. To address this mismatch, we propose LatentRM, a reward modeling framework that learns intermediate reasoning traces as discrete latent variables to explicitly maximize the likelihood of downstream scalar rewards. Through on-policy optimization of the latent reasoning space end-to-end, LatentRM tightly couples deep reasoning-based evaluation with precise scoring. Extensive validations on in-distribution and OOD datasets and RLHF show that LatentRM outperforms scalar, generative, and hybrid RMs on preference modeling and policy alignment across tasks ranging from open-ended conversation to complex reasoning.
title: Learning Latent Reasoning Traces for Scalar Reward Models End-to-End
title_translated: 端到端学习标量奖励模型的潜在推理轨迹
summary_translated: 奖励模型（RMs）是通过强化学习将大语言模型与人类偏好对齐的核心组件。尽管传统标量RMs能实现高效且概率化的奖励建模，但其依赖浅层线索，难以泛化到复杂或分布外（OOD）任务。相反，生成式RMs通过大量推理提升了在挑战性任务上的鲁棒性，但其基于自然语言的评分缺乏标量RMs所具有的数值灵活性和概率可解释性。虽然近期方法通过离策略多任务学习结合两种范式，但此类并行优化并不能保证生成的推理轨迹主动对齐或有助于下游标量奖励预测。为解决这一错配，我们提出LatentRM，一种奖励建模框架，将中间推理轨迹作为离散潜在变量进行学习，以显式最大化下游标量奖励的可能性。通过端到端的策略优化潜在推理空间，LatentRM紧密耦合深度推理评估与精确打分。在分布内和分布外数据集及RLHF上的大量验证表明，LatentRM在从开放式对话到复杂推理的各种任务中，均优于标量、生成式和混合型RMs，在偏好建模和策略对齐方面表现更优。

summary: Authorship Verification (AV) represents an important subfield of digital text forensics and addresses the fundamental question of whether two texts were written by the same author. Although the field has made substantial progress over the past two decades, several important challenges remain unresolved or underexplored. For instance, most AV research has focused on written texts, despite the fact that language is expressed not only in written but also in spoken form, such as in videos. Moreover, existing AV studies have predominantly concentrated on English, while other languages, including German, have received comparatively little attention. To address these research gaps, we apply AV to spoken language in the form of transcripts of German-language videos and examine the effectiveness of established AV methods in verifying a speaker's identity across video pairs. Our experimental evaluation, based on a total of ten AV methods applied to three self-compiled corpora comprising 300 videos from 150 speakers, shows that the best performance (up to 88% accuracy and 90% AUC) is achieved by traditional AV approaches based on simple character- and token n-gram representations. In contrast, more modern transformer-based approaches perform significantly worse on all evaluated corpora. Our results therefore suggest that traditional methods in the field of AV remain both competitive and relevant.
title: Authorship Verification of Transcribed German-Language Videos

title_translated: 德语视频转录文本的作者身份验证
summary_translated: 作者身份验证（AV）是数字文本取证的重要子领域，核心问题是判断两段文本是否由同一作者撰写。尽管过去二十年该领域取得了显著进展，但仍存在若干未解决或研究不足的挑战。例如，大多数AV研究集中于书面文本，而语言不仅以书面形式表达，也通过口语（如视频）呈现。此外，现有研究主要集中在英语，对其他语言（包括德语）的关注较少。为填补这些研究空白，我们首次将AV应用于德语视频的转录文本，评估现有AV方法在跨视频对中验证说话者身份的有效性。基于三个自建语料库（共300个视频，来自150位说话者）和十种AV方法的实验评估表明，基于简单字符和词元n-gram表示的传统AV方法表现最佳（准确率最高达88%，AUC达90%）。相比之下，更现代的基于Transformer的方法在所有评估语料库上表现显著较差。因此，我们的结果表明，传统AV方法在当前仍具有竞争力和相关性。

summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems (FDSDSs) can listen while speaking, enabling natural behaviors such as smooth turn-taking, backchannel handling, and user barge-in handling. However, fair comparisons in multi-turn conversations remain a challenge. In addition, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of languages and dialogue domains. We propose M3-DuplexBench, a multi-turn, multilingual, multidomain benchmark for FDSDSs. M3-DuplexBench supports English and Japanese and covers both casual conversation and multi-turn question answering. In addition, we evaluate models under multiple dialogue context settings, including single-turn, user-only, and teacher-forced full-context settings, to analyze how dialogue history affects model behavior. Experiments with recent FDSDSs reveal model-specific turn-taking characteristics, clear performance gaps across languages and domains, and mixed effects of dialogue context.
title: M3-DuplexBench: A Multi-Turn, Multilingual, Multidomain Benchmark for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
title_translated: M3-DuplexBench：面向全双工语音对话模型的多轮、多语言、多领域基准测试
summary_translated: 全双工语音对话系统（FDSDSs）能够在说话的同时监听，从而实现自然的交互行为，如流畅的换言、反馈信号处理以及用户打断处理。然而，在多轮对话中进行公平比较仍具挑战性，且现有基准测试在语言和对话领域覆盖范围有限。为此，我们提出了M3-DuplexBench，一个支持多轮、多语言、多领域的全双工语音对话系统基准测试。该基准涵盖英语和日语，覆盖日常对话与多轮问答两种场景。此外，我们在多种对话上下文设置下评估模型表现，包括单轮、仅用户输入、教师强制全上下文等设置，以分析对话历史如何影响模型行为。对近期FDSDS模型的实验揭示了模型特有的换言特征、不同语言与领域间明显的性能差距，以及对话上下文的混合影响。

summary: Child malnutrition remains a major public health challenge in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in South Asia, where early identification of vulnerable children is critical for timely intervention and resource allocation. This study aims to evaluate the feasibility, fairness, and temporal robustness of using a pretrained large language model (LLM) in a zero-shot setting for child stunting prediction using population health survey data. Using Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey (BDHS) data collected between 2007 and 2022, we transformed maternal, child, healthcare, and household characteristics into semantically interpretable prompt-based representations and evaluated GPT-4o-mini for zero-shot stunting prediction, comparing its performance against a random forest baseline and assessing fairness across demographic and socioeconomic groups as well as temporal robustness across survey waves. The results demonstrate that zero-shot inference using GPT-4o-mini achieved comparable balanced accuracy to the supervised baseline while exhibiting substantially higher sensitivity for identifying stunting cases, relatively consistent performance across child sex groups, and stable predictive behaviour across BDHS waves; however, important fairness disparities were observed across residence and household wealth categories, highlighting the need for further investigation before deployment of foundation models in public health prediction settings.
title: Can Zero-Shot LLMs Predict Child Malnutrition? A Fairness and Temporal Robustness Study
title_translated: 零样本大语言模型能否预测儿童营养不良？一项公平性与时间鲁棒性研究
summary_translated: 儿童营养不良仍是低收入和中等收入国家（尤其是南亚地区）的重大公共卫生挑战，早期识别脆弱儿童对于及时干预和资源分配至关重要。本研究旨在评估使用预训练大语言模型（LLM）在零样本设置下进行儿童发育迟缓预测的可行性、公平性及时间鲁棒性，基于孟加拉国人口健康调查（BDHS）2007至2022年间的数据。我们将母亲、儿童、医疗保健和家庭特征转化为语义可解释的基于提示的表示形式，并评估GPT-4o-mini在零样本条件下的发育迟缓预测表现，与随机森林基线模型对比，并评估其在不同人口统计学和社会经济群体中的公平性，以及在不同调查波次间的时序鲁棒性。结果显示，GPT-4o-mini的零样本推理在平衡准确率上与监督基线相当，且在识别发育迟缓病例方面表现出更高的敏感性，对儿童性别组的表现相对一致，且在各BDHS波次间预测行为稳定；但居住地和家庭财富类别间存在显著公平性差异，提示在公共健康预测场景中部署基础模型前需进一步研究。

summary: Training-free acceleration makes diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) more deployable, but it may silently change generated content. We study this serving-time consistency problem on 300 real images, comparing Fast-dLLM outputs with the same model's unaccelerated outputs. Across the mild parallelism induced in our long-form setting (1.05--1.25 committed tokens per step), confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but not baseline agreement. State-refresh ablations and an image-swap intervention instead identify stale visual and generated-text states as contributors to drift. For the tested Fast-dLLM implementation, shortening the KV-cache refresh interval yields a monotonic speed--agreement frontier and near-exact agreement at a measured 1.3x speedup. The initial diagnosis also appears with dLLM-Cache and LaViDa, although dLLM-Cache recovers agreement only after both caches are tightened, which removes its speed advantage. Independent prompts and images reproduce the threshold-insensitivity and refresh recovery. A targeted audit finds genuine content substitution in half of 50 low-agreement pairs. In a separate blinded two-annotator evaluation, the pooled accelerated-minus-baseline factual-error difference is 0.00 (95% CI [-0.17,+0.17]); this sample detects no difference but does not establish factual equivalence. Finally, none of the tested adaptive or smoothed-refresh variants beats the fixed interval at matched compute. Our contribution is a paired diagnostic and an implementation-scoped consistency control, not an accuracy or safety guarantee.
title: Faster but Different: Diagnosing and Controlling Content Drift in Accelerated Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: 更快但不同：加速多模态扩散语言模型中的内容漂移诊断与控制
summary_translated: 无需训练的加速技术使基于扩散的多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）更具可部署性，但可能悄然改变生成内容。我们在300张真实图像上研究了这一服务阶段的一致性问题，将Fast-dLLM的输出与同一模型未加速版本的输出进行对比。在长文本生成设定中（每步提交1.05–1.25个标记），置信度阈值调优虽改变了解码行为，但未影响基础一致性。状态刷新消融实验和图像替换干预则揭示了陈旧视觉状态和生成文本状态是导致内容漂移的关键因素。针对所测试的Fast-dLLM实现，缩短KV缓存刷新间隔可实现速度与一致性的单调权衡，并在1.3倍加速下达到近乎完全一致。初始诊断也在dLLM-Cache和LaViDa中出现，但dLLM-Cache仅在两个缓存均收紧后才恢复一致性，从而丧失其速度优势。独立提示和图像复现了阈值不敏感性和刷新恢复现象。定向审计发现，在50对低一致性样本中有半数存在真实内容替换。在另一项盲法双标注评估中，加速版减去基线的总体事实错误差值为0.00（95%置信区间[-0.17, +0.17]），该样本未检测到差异，但无法证明事实等价性。最后，所有测试的自适应或平滑刷新变体在相同计算量下均未优于固定间隔策略。本研究贡献在于一套成对诊断方法和一个面向具体实现的一致性控制方案，而非准确性或安全性保证。

summary: Deception detection has critical implications for legal proceedings, law enforcement, and online security. Although human judgment is limited in accuracy and scalability, Natural Language Processing (NLP) offers a data-driven alternative. We present a survey and comparative analysis of NLP-based Automatic Deception Detection (ADD) focusing on the legal domain, reviewing the evolution from feature-based machine learning to Large Language Model (LLM) approaches. We conduct a unified empirical evaluation across seven datasets (two legal, five general-domain), comparing six fine-tuned transformer models and seven LLMs under four prompting strategies. The results show strong domain sensitivity, with fine-tuned models excelling in data-rich general domains and few-shot LLMs remaining competitive in low-resource legal settings. Chain-of-Thought prompting often underperforms direct classification. These findings highlight the need for domain adaptation and interpretable systems in high-stakes legal contexts.
title: Semantics of Subterfuge: Benchmarking Legal Deception Detection Against General-domain State-of-the-Art
title_translated: 隐匿之语义：针对通用领域最先进方法的法律欺骗检测基准测试
summary_translated: 欺骗检测在法律程序、执法和在线安全中具有重要意义。尽管人类判断在准确性和可扩展性方面存在局限，自然语言处理（NLP）提供了数据驱动的替代方案。本文综述并对比分析了基于NLP的自动欺骗检测（ADD）在法律领域的应用，回顾了从基于特征的机器学习方法到大语言模型（LLM）方法的演进过程。我们在七个数据集（两个法律领域，五个通用领域）上进行了统一的实证评估，比较了六种微调的Transformer模型和七种LLM在四种提示策略下的表现。结果表明，模型表现具有强烈的领域敏感性：微调模型在数据丰富的通用领域表现优异，而少样本LLM在资源匮乏的法律领域仍具竞争力。思维链（Chain-of-Thought）提示通常表现不如直接分类。这些发现凸显了在高风险法律场景中进行领域适配和可解释系统设计的重要性。

summary: Deepseek's Engram, a conditional memory module, was introduced to trade-off storage versus reasoning in large language models. However, the module relies on token-level $N$-gram hashing for Engram embedding lookup, introducing a tight coupling to the tokenizer used: a model with a different tokenizer would have to train its own Engram embeddings from scratch. To improve the reusability of Engram embeddings, we propose a change to the hashing routine, enabling compatibility between Engram models using different tokenizers. Instead of modelling disjoint $N$-gram spaces, we treat $N$-gram as a method to sample potentially useful byte sequences, from all possible byte sequences across tokens. We replace the XOR-based hashing with the general polynomial hashing with a joint embedding space across $N$. This work investigates the possible trade-offs and shows that this simple substitution produces comparable performance and achieves tokenizer-agnosticism: hash equivalence for byte-equivalent token sequences.
title: Tokenizer-Agnostic Engram Module
title_translated: 无分词器依赖的痕迹模块
summary_translated: Deepseek提出的Engram是一种条件记忆模块，用于在大型语言模型中权衡存储与推理。然而，该模块依赖于基于token级N元语法哈希的Engram嵌入查找，导致与所用分词器紧密耦合：使用不同分词器的模型必须从头开始训练自己的Engram嵌入。为提高Engram嵌入的可重用性，我们提出修改哈希流程，实现使用不同分词器的Engram模型之间的兼容性。我们不再建模互不重叠的N元语法空间，而是将N元语法视为从所有可能的字节序列中采样潜在有用的字节序列的方法。我们用通用多项式哈希替代基于XOR的哈希，并建立跨N的联合嵌入空间。本研究探讨了可能的权衡，结果表明这一简单替换实现了相当的性能，并达到了无分词器依赖性：对于字节等价的标记序列具有哈希等价性。

summary: Inline notes and collected commentaries are important forms of scholarly communication that evolved within the Confucian exegetical tradition, yet have received little computational attention. Drawing on traditional Chinese exegetics and philology, this paper formulates collected commentary compilation as an NLP task and proposes a computational framework that preserves the contextual dependency of inline notes while enabling their automatic compilation and exegetical knowledge organization. It combines two-step prompt chaining for identifying the associated main-text segments and exegetical functions of annotations with cross-source mention clustering for integrating commentary across editions, achieving a CoNLL F1 score above 97% in a case study on the Classic of Mountains. Our framework lays the foundation for the large-scale organization of historical exegetical knowledge, thereby supporting a broad range of downstream philological and NLP tasks.
title: From Inline Notes to Collected Commentaries: Toward Context-Preserving Organization of Exegetical Knowledge in Classical Chinese Texts
title_translated: 从内联注释到汇编评注：面向古典中文文本诠释知识的上下文保持型组织
summary_translated: 内联注释和汇编评注是儒家诠释传统中重要的学术交流形式，但至今未受到足够的计算关注。本文结合中国传统诠释学与训诂学，将汇编评注的编纂定义为一项自然语言处理任务，并提出一种计算框架，在保留内联注释上下文依赖关系的同时，实现其自动汇编与诠释知识的组织。该框架结合两步提示链以识别注释相关的正文段落及其诠释功能，以及跨源提及聚类以整合不同版本间的评注，在《山海经》案例研究中取得了超过97%的CoNLL F1分数。该框架为大规模历史诠释知识的组织奠定了基础，从而支持广泛的下游训诂学与NLP任务。

summary: Recent language models achieve strong performance across a variety of tasks, but conventional adaptation applies updates uniformly across training samples regardless of their local update benefit. We propose PARALLEL, a prefrontal-aligned reinforcement inspired approach for language-model learning. Inspired by the complementary roles of goal-related and uncertainty-related control, PARALLEL represents these forms of information as separate controller signals and combines them with the current model representation. A reinforcement-inspired controller assigns sample-dependent update intensity using immediate utility-cost feedback. PARALLEL therefore learns when and how strongly to adapt to each sample, prioritizing beneficial updates while limiting unnecessary parameter changes. PARALLEL uses available updates more efficiently than selective baselines while retaining 94.1--99.2\% of Full-adaptation performance. Beyond multiple-choice reasoning, experiments on XSum and CNN/DailyMail show that PARALLEL retains 96.9--98.6\% of the ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2 scores achieved by Full adaptation and 98.8--98.9\% of the corresponding ROUGE-L scores. When compared at the same cumulative adaptation time or GPU energy, PARALLEL achieves higher ARC accuracy and exhibits a more stable late-stage adaptation trajectory than Full adaptation in the representative run. These results show that learning when and how strongly to update each sample supports stable and efficient post-deployment stream adaptation while avoiding unnecessary updates.
title: PARALLEL: A Prefrontal-Aligned Reinforcement inspired Approach for Language-Model Learning under Explicit Limits
title_translated: PARALLEL：一种前额叶对齐的强化学习启发式语言模型学习方法，适用于显式限制下的学习
summary_translated: 近期的语言模型在多种任务上表现出色，但传统的适应方法对所有训练样本均一化更新，无论其局部更新收益如何。我们提出PARALLEL，一种受前额叶调控机制启发的强化学习式语言模型学习方法。受目标相关与不确定性相关控制互补作用的启发，PARALLEL将这两种信息表示为独立的控制器信号，并将其与当前模型表示相结合。一个受强化学习启发的控制器利用即时效用-成本反馈分配样本相关的更新强度。因此，PARALLEL能够学习何时以及以多强程度适应每个样本，优先进行有益更新，同时限制不必要的参数变化。与选择性基线相比，PARALLEL更高效地利用可用更新，同时保持94.1–99.2%的全量适应性能。在多选题推理之外，XSum和CNN/DailyMail实验表明，PARALLEL保留了全量适应所获得的96.9–98.6% ROUGE-1和ROUGE-2得分，以及98.8–98.9%的ROUGE-L得分。在相同累计适应时间或GPU能耗下，PARALLEL在代表性运行中展现出更高的ARC准确率，并具有更稳定的后期适应轨迹。这些结果表明，学习何时以及以何种强度更新每个样本，有助于实现稳定且高效的部署后流式适应，同时避免不必要的更新。

summary: Heterogeneous Large Language Model (LLM) systems increasingly rely on shared contexts, retrieved evidence, and multi-agent dialogue histories, yet their internal key-value (KV) caches remain model-specific and cannot be reused across architectures. Consequently, each model must repeatedly prefill or store caches for the same context, limiting the scalability of multi-model reasoning and long-context generation. We propose Mixture-of-Translators(MoT), a cache translation framework that maps context KV caches from a source LLM into the cache space of a target LLM. Unlike prior approaches that depend on a single projection path or global shared latent space, MoT uses multiple translator modules to capture diverse source--target mappings. To further reduce residual translation error, we introduce a Context Correction Loss that aligns the replayed target trajectory with the native target trajectory. We reveal two competing failure modes in cache translation: propagated translation shift from early injection and last-state shift from late injection. MoT addresses them through translator mixtures and target-side correction. Across homogeneous and heterogeneous translations among Qwen2.5, GPT-2, and OPT models, MoT preserves downstream QA performance, including Qwen2.5-7B-scale translation with 51.0% average closed-set QA accuracy and 0.43 average extractive QA F1. In practical case studies, MoT enables quality-preserving memory reuse for multi-agent reasoning and retains 96.3% of direct-context quality in long-context cache-augmented generation, demonstrating scalable KV cache reuse across heterogeneous LLMs.
title: Mixture-of-Translators: Translating KV Caches Across Heterogeneous Large Language Models
title_translated: 混合翻译器：跨异构大语言模型的键值缓存翻译
summary_translated: 异构大语言模型（LLM）系统越来越多地依赖共享上下文、检索证据和多智能体对话历史，但其内部的键值（KV）缓存仍为模型特有，无法跨架构复用。因此，每个模型都需重复预填充或存储相同上下文的缓存，限制了多模型推理和长上下文生成的可扩展性。我们提出混合翻译器（MoT），一种缓存翻译框架，可将源LLM的上下文KV缓存映射到目标LLM的缓存空间。与依赖单一投影路径或全局共享潜在空间的先前方法不同，MoT使用多个翻译模块来捕捉多样化的源-目标映射关系。为进一步降低残余翻译误差，我们引入上下文校正损失，使重放的目标轨迹与原生目标轨迹对齐。我们揭示了缓存翻译中的两种竞争性失败模式：早期注入导致的传播翻译偏移和晚期注入导致的最终状态偏移。MoT通过翻译器混合与目标端校正加以解决。在Qwen2.5、GPT-2和OPT模型间进行同质与异质翻译实验，MoT保持了下游问答性能，包括Qwen2.5-7B规模的翻译达到平均51.0%封闭集问答准确率和0.43平均抽取式问答F1。在实际案例研究中，MoT实现了多智能体推理中的高质量记忆复用，并在长上下文缓存增强生成中保留了96.3%的直接上下文质量，展示了跨异构LLM的可扩展KV缓存复用能力。

summary: Large language models often improve task performance by generating long reasoning traces, but the resulting computation is frequently wasted on redundant verification and revision. Existing probe-based early-exit approaches mainly inspect explicit self-doubt expressions, leaving many earlier termination opportunities undetected. Expanding inspection to ordinary reasoning boundaries improves coverage, but also exposes highly diverse intermediate states whose predictive information may reside in different hidden layers. We present Boundary-Expanded and Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning (BLADE), a lightweight framework that dynamically terminates reasoning by estimating whether the generated prefix is sufficient for correct answering. BLADE constructs multi-granular checkpoints from sentence, self-doubt, and paragraph boundaries, and derives robust training labels through repeated answer completions. It further learns a compact subset of informative probe layers instead of relying on fixed choices or expensive representations from all layers. At inference time, calibrated predictions are combined with checkpoint-specific confirmation rules to balance responsiveness and premature-exit risk. Experiments on five benchmarks and two Qwen3 reasoning models show that BLADE preserves near-baseline accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 24.8% on Qwen3-8B and 15.8% on Qwen3-4B. Ablation studies further confirm the benefits of diverse checkpoints and automatic layer selection, demonstrating an effective approach to more efficient LLM reasoning.
title: BLADE: Boundary-Expanded and Layer-Adaptive Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning
title_translated: BLADE：边界扩展与层自适应动态退出，实现高效的大语言模型推理
summary_translated: 大型语言模型通常通过生成长推理链条来提升任务表现，但由此产生的计算往往在冗余的验证与修正上被浪费。现有的基于探测的早退方法主要检查明确的自我怀疑表达，导致许多早期终止机会未被发现。将检测范围扩展至普通推理边界虽提升了覆盖度，但也暴露了高度多样的中间状态，其预测信息可能分布在不同的隐藏层中。我们提出边界扩展与层自适应动态退出（BLADE），一种轻量级框架，通过估计生成前缀是否足以正确回答问题，实现推理的动态终止。BLADE从句子、自我怀疑和段落边界构建多粒度检查点，并通过重复答案补全生成鲁棒的训练标签。它进一步学习一个紧凑的有信息量的探测层子集，而非依赖固定选择或所有层的昂贵表示。推理时，经过校准的预测与特定检查点的确认规则相结合，以平衡响应速度与过早退出风险。在五个基准测试和两个Qwen3推理模型上的实验表明，BLADE在保持接近基线准确率的同时，使Qwen3-8B生成的token减少24.8%，Qwen3-4B减少15.8%。消融研究进一步证实了多样化检查点和自动层选择的优势，展示了一种更高效的LLM推理有效方法。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in the distribution of scarce resources, raising concerns about biased allocations based on characteristics like race and gender. Recent LLM audits have produced inconsistent results, however, finding evidence of both positive and negative discrimination towards women and ethnic minorities, even for the same models. We show that this disagreement can arise from differences in audit format and introduce FairFund-Bench, a benchmark that systematically varies key features of previous audit designs: the evaluation task (rating, ranking, or allocation), comparison context (single or multi-stimulus), and whether the audit is transparent or disguised. The benchmark comprises 600 requests for financial assistance created from human-authored templates (calibrated against 1.3M real GoFundMe campaigns) across three domains, four race and two gender categories, and five causal framings of need derived from welfare deservingness theory. Across 14 models, audit format changes the direction of bias: models advantage minorities when rating claimants individually but penalize some groups when ranking them side by side. Bias magnitude, though small overall, is several times greater in disguised audits than in transparent ones, where, faced with appeals differing only in claimants' names, models overwhelmingly split funds equally. Causal framing effects, by contrast, exceed demographic effects by roughly an order of magnitude and are consistent across models and audit formats, indicating that current LLMs robustly reproduce human deservingness evaluations. The benchmark scores models on four criteria (demographic bias, deservingness alignment, cross-task consistency, and cross-context consistency), is publicly available, and can be readily adapted to other substantive domains.
title: FairFund-Bench: Evaluating Distributive Bias in LLM Resource Allocation
